items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: So we became a team called Laine and Hodes, which always irritated me at that time because I thought it should be Hodes and Laine.

ctx.x: He was from Cleveland. But he'd been -- I didn't think he needed Frankie Laine at all. But Joe was that kind of kind person. He just -- he needs the air time, give him a break. And so he let him sing. And that's where we met. I'd come in there a couple of times, and he'd sing and I'd play. We were both out or work, so he thought it was -- I might be getting a little ahead, but I'd like to get this part, because he thought it would be a good idea that two can do better what one can't seem to do. Let's join forces.

So we became a team called Laine and Hodes, which always irritated me at that time because I thought it should be Hodes and Laine. In fact, when we got the team up to the point where we'd make $50 a week apiece, it became too much for us.
